description: The ocean component of IITM-ESMv3-HR is based on the MOM4p1 (Modular Ocean Model version 4.1), configured with a 1° horizontal resolution and 50 vertical levels, using a z* vertical coordinate with partial bottom cells. Key physical parameterizations include Gent–McWilliams/Redi mesoscale eddy mixing, K-profile parameterization (KPP) for vertical mixing, bottom boundary-layer processes, and sea-surface boundary fluxes. The model represents the key processes governing ocean circulation, heat and freshwater transport, mixed-layer evolution, mesoscale eddies, and air–sea interactions, which are central to the simulation of ocean heat transport, AMOC and climate variability.
